name: Beef Kofta Bowls with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Mix beef, onion, parsley, garlic, spices, salt; shape kofta; grill 12 minutes.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with tomato, cucumber, yogurt-tahini-lemon sauce.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Chimichurri & Cauliflower
steps: Roast cauliflower with a third of the oil at 425°F 22 minutes.
Sear seasoned pork; roast 15 minutes; rest, slice.
Blend remaining oil, herbs, garlic, vinegar, oregano, pepper flakes; spoon over.

name: Beef & Cauliflower Shepherd's Skillet
steps: Brown beef with onion, carrot, garlic; add tomato paste, broth, thyme, peas; simmer 8 minutes.
Steam and mash cauliflower; spread over the skillet.
Top with cheddar; broil 4 minutes.

name: Pork Chops with Kale & White Beans
steps: Season chops; sear 4–5 minutes per side; rest.
Sauté garlic and kale in the pan; add beans and broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon and pepper flakes; serve with chops.

name: Beef Satay with Cucumber Salad
steps: Marinate steak strips in tamari, garlic, ginger, curry powder, coconut milk 20 minutes; skewer; grill 3 minutes per side.
Whisk peanut butter, lime, sriracha, warm water.
Toss cucumber and onion with rice vinegar; serve with satay and sauce.

name: Italian Beef Stuffed Mushrooms (Large)
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, seasoning; add spinach and marinara.
Fill caps; top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Pork Lettuce Cups with Peanut Sauce
steps: Brown pork with garlic, ginger, half the tamari.
Whisk peanut butter, remaining tamari, lime, sriracha, water.
Fill lettuce with pork, carrot, cucumber, cilantro; drizzle sauce; top with peanuts.

name: Beef Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Brown beef in oil with garlic and ginger.
Add cabbage and carrot; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Lamb & Eggplant Moussaka (Lightened)
steps: Slice eggplant; brush with oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Brown lamb with onion, garlic; add tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano; simmer 15 minutes.
Layer eggplant and lamb; top with yogurt whisked with eggs, parmesan, nutmeg; bake at 375°F 35 minutes.

name: Cajun Pork Chops with Collard Greens
steps: Sauté bacon, onion, garlic; add collards, broth, vinegar; simmer covered 20 minutes.
Rub chops with Cajun seasoning; sear 4–5 minutes per side.
Serve chops over greens.

name: Beef & Vegetable Skillet with Sweet Potato
steps: Sauté diced sweet potato in oil covered 8 minutes.
Add beef, pepper, onion, garlic, spices; cook 8 minutes.
Stir in kale; top with avocado.

name: Pork Chops with Creamy Dijon Sauce
steps: Sear seasoned chops; remove.
Sauté shallot and garlic; add broth, Dijon, thyme; reduce; stir in yogurt off heat.
Return chops to coat; serve with steamed broccoli.

name: Ground Beef Zucchini Skillet with Feta
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Pork Tenderloin Banh Mi Bowls
steps: Marinate pork slices in tamari, garlic, fish sauce; sear in oil.
Quick-pickle shredded carrot and daikon in rice vinegar 15 minutes.
Bowl cauliflower rice, pork, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, sriracha mayo.

name: Beef & Black Bean Chili Verde
steps: Brown beef with onion, garlic, cumin.
Add salsa verde, chiles, beans, broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with cilantro and yogurt.

name: Pork Schnitzel (Almond Crust) with Cucumber Salad
steps: Dip cutlets in egg then almond flour-parmesan-paprika.
Pan-fry in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Toss cucumber with yogurt, dill, vinegar; serve with lemon.

name: Beef Sirloin with Roasted Vegetable Medley
steps: Roast vegetables with half the oil, garlic, rosemary at 425°F 20 minutes.
Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Drizzle vegetables with balsamic; serve.

name: Lamb Curry with Spinach
steps: Brown lamb cubes; remove. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes, yogurt, lamb; simmer covered 60 minutes.
Stir in spinach; garnish cilantro; serve with cauliflower rice.

name: Pork & Pepper Fajita Skillet
steps: Sauté pork strips with spices in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers and onion until charred; return pork; add lime.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and yogurt.

name: Beef Stew with Mushrooms & Red Wine (Slow Cooker)
steps: Sear beef cubes in oil.
Add to slow cooker with all ingredients.
Cook on low 7 hours; serve over cauliflower mash.

name: Pork Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes.
Mix pork, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic, parsley, salt; form meatballs; brown in oil; simmer in marinara 15 minutes.
Serve over squash strands.

name: Steak Salad Bowl with Blue Cheese & Walnuts
steps: Sear steak 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Toss greens, tomato, onion with oil and balsamic.
Top with steak, blue cheese, walnuts.

name: Pork Ramen Bowl (Shirataki)
steps: Simmer broth with garlic, ginger, tamari, mushrooms 10 minutes; add bok choy.
Sear sliced pork 2 minutes per side.
Whisk miso into broth; assemble with rinsed shirataki, pork, halved eggs, green onion, sesame oil, nori.

name: Beef Empanada-Style Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown beef with onion, garlic, spices; add tomatoes, olives, chopped egg.
Fill peppers; top with cotija; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Pork Green Bean Almond Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry pork strips in oil; remove.
Stir-fry green beans with garlic, ginger 5 minutes.
Return pork with tamari, vinegar, sesame oil; toss with toasted almonds.

name: Beef Gyro Bowls
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt; press into a thin sheet and bake at 425°F 15 minutes; slice into strips.
Sauté cauliflower rice.
Bowl with tomato, cucumber, onion, feta, yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Fennel & Orange
steps: Toss fennel and onion with half the oil; roast at 425°F 15 minutes.
Add seasoned pork and orange slices; roast 15 minutes more.
Rest and slice; spoon pan juices over.

name: Beef & Broccoli Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Brown beef with garlic and ginger; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli and cauliflower rice 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return beef with tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Lamb Burgers with Feta & Tzatziki (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mix lamb, garlic, oregano, mint, salt; form patties; grill 5 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, dill.
Serve in lettuce with feta, tomato, onion, tzatziki.

name: Pork & Brussels Sprout Sheet Pan
steps: Toss sprouts and onion with oil; spread on a pan.
Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme; add to pan.
Roast at 425°F 22 minutes; drizzle vinegar over sprouts.

name: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan; rub with oil, garlic, salt, pepper; top with lemon slices.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 minutes.
Finish with dill and lemon juice.

name: Shrimp Scampi Zoodles
steps: Sauté garlic in oil and butter 30 seconds; add shrimp, cook 2 minutes per side; remove.
Add wine and lemon juice; reduce 1 minute; add zoodles and toss 2 minutes.
Return shrimp; top with parsley, parmesan, pepper flakes.

name: Blackened Cod with Mango Salsa
steps: Rub cod with spices and salt; sear in oil 3–4 minutes per side.
Dice mango, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve fish over cauliflower rice with salsa.

name: Tuna Poke Bowl with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Cube tuna; toss with tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, green onion.
Steam cauliflower rice 4 minutes; cool.
Bowl with avocado, cucumber, edamame, seaweed, tuna; top sesame.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Asparagus
steps: Sauté asparagus in oil 4 minutes; remove.
Melt butter with garlic; add shrimp, cook 3 minutes.
Return asparagus; finish with lemon, parsley, pepper flakes.

name: Salmon Burgers with Avocado Slaw
steps: Pulse salmon; mix with egg, almond flour, Dijon, green onion, dill, salt; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mash avocado with yogurt and lime; toss with slaw; serve with burgers.

name: Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Season fish with chili powder, cumin, salt; sear in oil 3–4 minutes per side; flake.
Toss cabbage with yogurt, mayo, lime, cilantro, jalapeño.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw, avocado.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon with Bok Choy
steps: Whisk miso, tamari, vinegar, ginger, sesame oil; brush on salmon.
Broil 8–10 minutes.
Sauté bok choy with garlic in avocado oil; top salmon with sesame.

name: Shrimp & Cauliflower Grits
steps: Steam cauliflower; blend with milk, cheddar, butter, salt into 'grits'.
Crisp bacon; sauté shrimp with garlic and Cajun seasoning in oil 3 minutes; add lemon.
Serve shrimp over grits with bacon and green onion.

name: Pesto Baked Cod with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Spread pesto over cod; surround with tomatoes and zucchini tossed in oil.
Bake at 400°F 14 minutes.
Squeeze lemon over.

name: Coconut Curry Shrimp
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, curry paste in oil 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, pepper, snap peas; simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; finish with fish sauce, lime, basil; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocados
steps: Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, celery, onion, lemon, pepper.
Halve avocados.
Fill with tuna salad; top chives.

name: Seared Scallops with Cauliflower Purée
steps: Simmer cauliflower with garlic in milk and water; blend with half the butter and salt.
Pat scallops dry; sear in oil 90 seconds per side.
Wilt spinach in remaining butter; plate purée, spinach, scallops; finish with lemon and chives.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
steps: Toss shrimp, peppers, onion with oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.
Squeeze lime; serve in tortillas with avocado and cilantro.

name: Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Season halibut; sear in oil 4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, capers, lemon juice; spoon over fish 1 minute.
Serve with steamed green beans and parsley.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Bowls (No-Sugar)
steps: Simmer tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener, arrowroot slurry into a glaze; add sesame oil.
Broil salmon 8 minutes, brushing with glaze.
Serve over mixed brown and cauliflower rice with steamed broccoli, sesame and green onion.

name: Shrimp Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic in oil 3 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime, sriracha, water.
Fill lettuce with shrimp, carrot, cucumber, cilantro; drizzle sauce; top peanuts.

name: Mediterranean Baked Tilapia
steps: Place tilapia in a dish; top with tomato, olives, onion, garlic, oregano, oil, lemon.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown sausage in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers, zucchini, onion, garlic 6 minutes.
Add shrimp and Cajun seasoning; cook 3 minutes; return sausage; finish with lemon.

name: Tuna Steak with Sesame Crust & Slaw
steps: Press tuna into sesame seeds; sear in avocado oil 1–2 minutes per side; slice.
Whisk tamari, sesame oil, vinegar, ginger; toss half with slaw.
Serve tuna over slaw with remaining sauce and green onion.

name: Salmon Cakes with Dill Yogurt
steps: Mix salmon, eggs, almond flour, green onion, Dijon, lemon zest; form 8 cakes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon juice; serve cakes over greens.

name: Garlic Shrimp Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Sauté shrimp with half the garlic in oil; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, remaining garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice 5 minutes.
Add peas, shrimp, tamari, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Broiled Salmon with Avocado Salsa
steps: Rub salmon with oil, cumin, salt; broil 8–10 minutes.
Dice avocado, tomato, onion, jalapeño; toss with cilantro and lime.
Serve salmon over greens with salsa.

name: Shrimp & Zucchini Pesto Skillet
steps: Sauté zucchini chunks with garlic in oil 4 minutes.
Add shrimp and tomatoes; cook 3 minutes.
Toss with pesto; top parmesan and lemon.

name: Crab Cakes (Almond Flour) with Remoulade
steps: Mix crab, egg, almond flour, half the mayo, Dijon, Old Bay, green onion; form 8 cakes; chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes per side.
Mix yogurt, remaining mayo, chopped pickle, hot sauce, lemon; serve over arugula.

name: Lemon Dill Baked Trout
steps: Lay trout on a pan with broccolini; rub with oil, garlic, salt; top with lemon slices and dill.
Bake at 400°F 12–15 minutes.
Serve with lemon juice.

name: Shrimp Ceviche with Avocado
steps: Poach shrimp 2–3 minutes; chop; chill.
Toss with lime, tomato, onion, cucumber, cilantro, jalapeño, salt; marinate 30 minutes.
Fold in avocado and oil.

name: Sardine & White Bean Salad Plate
steps: Toss beans, tomato, onion, parsley, capers with lemon and oil.
Plate over arugula.
Top with sardines.

name: Shrimp Pad See Ew (Zoodles)
steps: Stir-fry garlic and shrimp in oil 2 minutes; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add broccolini 2 minutes; add zoodles, tamari, fish sauce, sweetener.
Toss 2 minutes.

name: Salmon with Roasted Brussels & Walnuts
steps: Roast halved sprouts with two-thirds of the oil at 425°F 12 minutes.
Add salmon rubbed with Dijon, garlic, remaining oil; roast 12 minutes more.
Top with walnuts and lemon.

name: Tilapia Veracruz
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, jalapeño in oil; add tomatoes, olives, capers, oregano; simmer 8 minutes.
Nestle tilapia in the sauce; cover; cook 8 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Shrimp Stuffed Avocado Boats
steps: Sauté shrimp in oil 3 minutes; chop; cool.
Mix with yogurt, lime, cilantro, onion, jalapeño, salt.
Fill avocado halves.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato & Olive Tapenade
steps: Pulse olives, sun-dried tomato, capers, garlic, oil into tapenade.
Bake cod at 400°F 12 minutes; top with tapenade last 3 minutes.
Serve with green beans, lemon, basil.

name: Shrimp Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Sauté shrimp with garlic and ginger in oil; remove.
Add slaw, tamari, vinegar; cook 5 minutes; scramble eggs in.
Return shrimp; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Salmon Nicoise Bowl
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes; blanch green beans; boil eggs.
Whisk oil, Dijon, vinegar.
Arrange greens, salmon, beans, eggs, tomato, olives, capers; drizzle dressing.

name: Spicy Shrimp Lettuce Tacos
steps: Toss shrimp with spices and garlic; sauté in oil 3 minutes.
Fill romaine leaves with shrimp.
Top with pico, avocado, cotija, lime.

name: Mussels in Tomato Garlic Broth
steps: Sauté shallot and garlic in oil; add wine and tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes.
Add mussels; cover; cook 5–6 minutes until open.
Top with parsley, lemon, pepper flakes.

name: Almond-Crusted Tilapia with Green Beans
steps: Pulse almonds with parmesan, garlic powder, paprika; dip fish in egg then crumbs.
Bake at 425°F 12 minutes.
Serve with green beans and lemon.

name: Shrimp & Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger in oil 4 minutes; add broth and cover 2 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook 3 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, arrowroot slurry, sesame oil; toss; top sesame.

name: Salmon & Quinoa Power Bowl
steps: Roast salmon 12 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water; massage half into kale.
Bowl quinoa, kale, cucumber, edamame, avocado, salmon; drizzle remaining dressing.

name: Lobster & Avocado Salad
steps: Mix lobster with celery, chives, lemon, mayo, yogurt, pepper.
Fold in avocado.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Blackened Salmon Caesar Bowl
steps: Rub salmon with Cajun seasoning; sear 4 minutes per side.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, oil.
Toss romaine with dressing; top salmon, parmesan, avocado.

name: Garlic Shrimp with Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast halved squash 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Sauté garlic in oil and butter; add shrimp 3 minutes; add tomatoes and spinach.
Toss with squash, lemon, parmesan, pepper flakes.

name: Cod en Papillote with Vegetables
steps: Place julienned vegetables on parchment; top with cod, lemon slices, thyme, oil, wine, salt.
Fold parchment into sealed packets.
Bake at 400°F 15–18 minutes; open at the table.

name: Shrimp Sushi Bowls (Cauliflower Rice)
steps: Steam cauliflower rice; season with rice vinegar; cool.
Sauté shrimp 3 minutes.
Bowl with avocado, cucumber, carrot, edamame, nori strips; drizzle tamari and sriracha mayo; sprinkle sesame.
